templates.why_chosen: Medium-confidence, 14-component microarchitecture instance of the pattern: a Data-plane core with six sub-blocks sits between top bus-address pills and a bottom Control Plane band, flanked left and right by matching Register File Interface columns.
templates.what_to_learn: The flanked-core sandwich also works for on-chip blocks: use bus-width labels on the connecting lines instead of arrows, and colour every block by whether it scales with datapath width so the tunable parameter is visible at a glance; the weakness is that wiring beyond bus widths stays unlabelled, so name the bus's purpose too.
